name: OOM 故障排查与实战案例

tools.gcore: jmap连不上时的兜底, gcore -o core $PID

caseStudy.background: 报表系统, HttpClient补数据, Guava缓存, 3GB堆→OOM

round2.MaxTenuringThreshold=3: 对象快速晋升老年代(报表对象存活时间长)
round2.CMSScavengeBeforeRemark: CMS Remark前先Minor GC清新生代, 减少扫描量
round2.ParallelRefProcEnabled: 并行处理Reference, weak refs从4.5秒缩短

caseStudy.round3: 升级8C16G→堆大Minor GC>1秒→换G1目标200ms→GC更频繁但停顿小
caseStudy.round4: 代码优化: select*→必须字段, Guava Cache→弱引用, 限制文件大小+拆分超大查询

lessons: 先加硬件缓口气再改代码治根
报表类系统对象长命→MaxTenuringThreshold压低不是坏事

notes: OOM→加内存→GC长→调参→换G1→代码优化治根；MaxTenuringThreshold/CMSScavengeBeforeRemark/ParallelRefProcEnabled三组合
